title: Quarterly release sequencing and experiment-sprint packaging for Dedicated capacity & autoscale
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define a reproducible quarterly cadence for sequencing Dedicated pool feature releases (capacity configuration, autoscale policies, burst lanes) alongside a packaged set of experiments that can be run in each cycle. Goal: reduce release surface area, shorten rollback time, and increase confidence in autoscale parameter changes through gated experiment bundles.
milestones: Milestone 1: Cadence design sign-off (stakeholders: Product, Eng, SRE) - target 2026-02-26
Milestone 2: Packaging of 3 experiment bundles + gating checks - target 2026-03-12
Milestone 3: Pilot rollout to non-critical dedicated pools - target 2026-03-20
Milestone 4: Full rollout + monitor window closure - target 2026-03-30
acceptance_criteria: A documented cadence doc approved by Eng, SRE, and GTM describing release windows, freeze periods, and rollback play
At least 3 independent experiment bundles created with clear hypothesis, metrics, and automatic rollback criteria
Pilot runs completed against 2 dedicated pools with no >5% latency regression or >2x cost increase for sustained 1-hour windows
Runbook updated and ops playbook validated with at least one SRE runbook rehearsal
risks: Concurrent experiment rollouts could interact and produce non-linear effects on caching and batching; mitigate by tagging experiments and enforcing isolation rules
Insufficient telemetry per pool might hide regressions; mitigate by adding short-lived increase in metric retention for rollout windows
Customer-facing latency spikes during peak traffic; mitigate via canary sizing and automatic downgrade to conservative autoscale profile
monitoring_and_slo: Primary SLOs to watch: 95th percentile token latency (target: <220ms for dedicated-optimized models), request success rate (>99.9%)
Cost delta metric: per-token cost change compared to baseline over a 6-hour sliding window
Experiment health signals: error rate, queue depth, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate
Alerting: automated alerts for any metric breach plus on-call paging for sustained breaches >10min
rollout_plan: Phase A - Canary: deploy experiment bundle to 2 small non-production dedicated pools for 24h
Phase B - Pilot: expand to 10% of staging customer traffic with aggressive monitoring for 72h
Phase C - Controlled ramp: open to 30% of targeted dedicated pools for one full business day with SRE shadow on-call
Phase D - Full release: remaining pools after 48h of stable metrics; schedule post-mortem within 5 business days
